row.title: teacher screen (workstream T)
row.question: Does any challenger teacher beat the incumbent stella_en_400M_v5 on the closed-form distilled TABLE by more than the swap's CI-widening penalty?
row.endpoint: closed-form distilled table, equal-weight dev macro of nDCG@10 over cqadup-programmers and cqadup-physics, per-query, int8-irrelevant (closed form)
row.comparator: the incumbent stella_en_400M_v5, re-probed in the IDENTICAL frame (mandatory control)
row.bar: ALL FOUR: (1) challenger beats incumbent CI-resolved = raw two-sided 95% paired_dep CI excludes 0 AND signflip_dep p < 0.05; (2) point-estimate margin > the challenger's PRE-CLASSIFIED CI-widening penalty (0.0050 near-sibling / 0.0096 dissimilar, classification fixed below before any result); (3) per-component point-estimate delta >= 0 on BOTH nq-250k AND hotpotqa (one negative component is a reversal and fails); (4) Dylan signs off.
row.multiplicity: Holm across the challenger set at alpha = 0.05
row.no_survivor: keep the incumbent -- same-teacher is the registered default
row.tie_break: two candidates are tied iff the raw 95% CI of their difference lies entirely within +/-0.0040; among tied candidates prefer no disclosed overlap with the protected sets, then the smaller dimension
row.statistic: boot.paired_dep (B=10000, seed 0) + boot.signflip_dep (R=100000, seed 0), strict alignment
row.fit_list: regenerated through the current protected-query filter; M7's work/trainq_texts.json has 1.31% R1 hits and is unusable
